description.value: Keating Coffee is a small weekday café on the Saanich Peninsula focused on quality fair-trade organic coffee and fresh homemade food, situated next to the Co-op Grocery on Keating Cross Road. The kitchen makes soups from scratch and builds sandwiches and paninis with local produce and bread from nearby bakeries — a practical fuelling stop for a cyclist passing through Saanichton. Customers consistently rate it among the best coffee spots on the Peninsula, and the café also offers catering.

address.value: 2126B Keating Cross Road, Saanichton, BC V8M 2A6

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at keatingcoffee.com fully loaded and corroborates the OSM address (2126B Keating Cross Road, Saanichton, BC V8M 2A6) and provides a phone number (250-652-1888) absent from OSM. The phrase 'grab your coffee on the go' and a dedicated Catering menu item confirm takeout is available. No website or OSM evidence addresses bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or other cycling-specific amenities, so those remain null.

OSM has no phone number; 250-652-1888 was sourced from the website only, so contact_confirmed.phone is null rather than true.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible café with a functioning website, confirmed address, and food/drink relevant to touring cyclists.

wow_evidence: soups from scratch… sandwiches and paninis with local produce… grab your coffee on the go
